scripts.db:migrate: varlock run --inject vars --path ../../apps/web/ --filter=DATABASE_URL -- sh -c 'bun scripts/local.ts ensure && drizzle-kit migrate'
scripts.db:push: varlock run --inject vars --path ../../apps/web/ --filter=DATABASE_URL -- sh -c 'bun scripts/local.ts ensure --local && drizzle-kit push'
scripts.db:rehearse: varlock run --inject vars --path ../../apps/web/ --filter=DATABASE_URL -- sh -c 'bun scripts/local.ts reset && drizzle-kit migrate'
scripts.db:studio: varlock run --inject vars --path ../../apps/web/ --filter=DATABASE_URL -- sh -c 'bun scripts/local.ts ensure && drizzle-kit studio'
